request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material and fur texture, soft natural daylight and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

A cat ON THE ROOF. An adult gray tabby cat with a white chest and a plain blue collar sits calmly on the red tiles of the pitched roof of a small family house, near the ridge, seen from the garden below on a clear day. The roof fills the upper half of the photo against a plain blue sky and the top of the house's pale wall is below it; the cat is small against the roof but sharp and clearly a cat. Exactly one cat; no people, no birds, no other animals. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere.
